body: Please ensure that clippy warnings are addressed.

I am using the regular `VersionFormatter` within this function. The raw version number produced by godot has a dot and text following the major.minor.patch numbers which breaks `VersionFormatter`, so I had to wrap it to remove that component. Is there a different way I should have fixed that?
Change pushed. Thanks for catching this one!

For the `Regex` I am a bit concerned about the current error handling approach and the fairly strict regex forcing a 3-number version. (I assume it's still parsable as `Complex`/`Mess`, so adding support for that into the formatter may work. Reformatting into a `General`/`Version`-style version string with just the version number and hash might be a good idea).

In general, for a prompt the full version feels too verbose by default so I would also prefer defaulting to `$numver` or a different `version_format`.
